base_stability_caveat: 2026-07-22 Day 4: with the base UNSTABLE, a spurious lightly-damped mode appeared at 3.279 Hz (zeta 0.88%) and masked the true f1 (2.942 Hz, zeta 3.8%); f2/f3 were unchanged (they involve little base motion). Evidence kept in characterisation/day4_baseline_ATTEMPT1. CHECK BASE STABILITY BEFORE EVERY SET - an unstable base fabricates a plausible fundamental and would corrupt any f1-based localisation.
damage_location_correction: Days 2-3 mislabelled damage locations. bottom/S1 = BASE PLATE (boundary condition, not storey), middle/S2 = Floor 2, top/S3 = Floor 3. Floor 1 NEVER tested. 4 plates with screws, 3 storeys (3 DOF confirmed - no 4th mode near 15.9 Hz in a 60 Hz search). See characterisation/DAMAGE_LOCATION_MAP.md.
day2_pilot: Severe storey-1 damage: f1 2.909->1.206 Hz (-58.5%, p<1e-13), reversible 102%. All gates pass. Reassembly repeatability ~1% sets the lightest-attributable-damage floor above the 0.6% measurement floor.
day3_localisation: Severe at each storey, f1 shift: bottom -59.4%, middle -34.3%, top -9.1% (monotonic with damage height). Signatures distinct (angles 30/41/71 deg) -> localisation MOTIVATED not proven (1 repeat each). Top higher-modes unreliable (harmonics).
day3_severity: Bottom storey graded (vs healthy): light(1/2t) f1-14%/f2-10%, moderate(1t) f1-46%/f2-14%, severe(3t) f1-59%/f2-17%. Monotonic -> severity resolves. Nonlinear in turns (saturates past ~1t). f1 goes nonlinear/unstable at light/moderate; f2 best stable gradable detector.
day4_localisation_complete: Four locations, 3 replicates each, vs day4_baseline. f1 shift: base -58.7+/-0.5, F1 -60.5+/-0.1, F2 -39.6+/-0.0, F3 -15.5+/-0.0. All 6 pairs distinct; 5 on f1 alone (36-496 sigma), base-vs-F1 only 3 sigma on f1 but 53 sigma on f3. NO SINGLE MODE LOCALISES - needs full 3-mode vector. Feasibility not general proof. F3 higher modes harmonic-ambiguous. Baseline stable <0.75% over campaign.
linearity_note: LINEAR over a 2.2x drive range (0.325-0.722 g RMS; 0.8A/1.4V, 1.2A/2.2V, 1.7A/2.8V), 3 repeats per gain. t=-0.63 p=0.573. Pooled within-gain sd 0.0518 Hz (1.79%) -> can only detect shifts >3.59%. Group means non-monotonic (2.884/3.017/2.856) = scatter not trend. NOTE an earlier 3-capture run (no repeats) gave a spurious NONLINEAR 4.76%; repeats at each gain were what distinguished noise from signal.
note: 2026-07-21 GATE 1 PASS. Three modes confirmed by linear sweep (1-15 Hz, no clipping, 10x headroom) AND ringdown (7 taps): f1=2.94, f2=8.10, f3=12.19 Hz. Ratios 1:2.751:4.141 vs uniform-shear theory 1:2.879:4.412 (-4 to -6%) identify them as modes 1-3 of one structure, resolving f1. Bias-corrected -0.245%. Pre/post-sweep taps agree to 0.12% on modes 2,3 -> max-gain sweep caused no damage. Shaker delivers nothing above ~12 Hz, so f4 (~15 Hz predicted) is unreachable.
reassembly_floor_note: Day 3, 5 full teardown/rebuild cycles: f1 sd 0.0046 Hz = 0.15% (f2 0.23%, f3 0.16%). Use 0.30% (2-sigma) as lightest attributable grade. Supersedes the Day 2 single-cycle ~1-2% estimate. Healthy f1 has settled to ~2.96 Hz (from morning 2.909).
storeys: 3 movable storeys (1=bottom, 3=top/sensor); ground bolted to table = base, not a DOF
